title: BBEA Input Schema v2.0
description: Structured input for Black Belt Ethical Auditor (Ollama/Llama fine-tune). Each field maps to one or more evaluation pillars.

style.description: Martial art or combatives system. Examples: 'Taekwondo WT', 'IBJJF BJJ', 'Shotokan Karate', 'MCMAP'.

belt_level.description: Rank or level being evaluated. Examples: '1st Dan Black Belt', 'Shodan', 'Black Belt 2nd Degree'.

jurisdiction.description: Legal context. Currently scoped exclusively to U.S. self-defense and proportionality law.

legitimacy_hint.description: Optional classification hint. Model performs its own legitimacy assessment regardless.

conduct_observations.description: Observed behaviors, incidents, or notes. Feed Pillar 2 (Conduct) evaluation.
examples: Consistently arrives early and assists with warmups
Intervenes calmly in minor student conflicts

ethical_responses.description: Practitioner's answers to ethical/right-to-choose questions. Feed Pillar 3 (Ethics).
examples: States preference for de-escalation before physical engagement
Affirms refusal to use skills in non-defensive situations

legal_context.description: Optional self-defense, use-of-force, or local policy context. Feed Pillar 4 (Law).

auditor_notes.description: Optional free-text notes from the human auditor or compliance officer.
